meta.title: Change Evaluator During Event: refused for a user without the Buyer/Evaluator role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer/Evaluator role and verify that Change Evaluator During Event is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Buyer/Evaluator and verify that evaluator reassignment is available.
Record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer/Evaluator role and verify that Change Evaluator During Event is refused or absent.; Repeat the action as a Buyer/Evaluator and verify that evaluator reassignment is available.; Record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

steps.note: Open an existing event so the evaluator-change behavior can be attempted in an active event context.

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer/Evaluator user and a Buyer/Evaluator user, attempt Change Evaluator During Event for both, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: Alternate buyer-role credentials and the evaluator reassignment action are not expressible by catalog steps.
Confirm the event screen remains usable after the tester's role-based attempts.
